title: Graph-normalized module pullback at an open
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E of Q_ell, an open immersion e:V→W with independent universes, and an operation presentation o [def-sf-integral-open-operations]. For the actual completed-ring module pullback and its specified adjunction [def-a1-integral-completed-tower-pullback-universes], there is a natural ordinary isomorphism pull ≅ restrict. It carries the adjunction unit generator x restricted along sliceGraph(Z) to the section restrictionSection(M,Z,x) of [def-sf-augmented-strict-integral-completion]. No quotient descent, tower comparison or inverse-limit assertion is made. No degree or quasi-compactness hypotheses are imposed.

from.place: Open-factor argument: Graph-normalized exact localization of strict module pullback.

lean.statement:
theorem openExactPullbackLocalization :
    ∃ ordinary : pull l E e ≅ restrict l E e o,
      ∀ (M : Modules l E W)
        (Z : Over (IntegralOpenReduction.openObject e)) (x : M.val.obj (op Z.left)),
        (ordinary.hom.app M).val.app (op ((IntegralOpenReduction.sliceSite e).obj Z))
          (((pull l E e).obj M).val.map (sliceGraph e Z).op
            (((adjunction l E e).unit.app M).val.app (op Z.left) x)) =
          restrictionSection l E e o M Z x
